segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: You wanted to talk pricing - what is the concern exactly?

segments.speaker: PROSPECT
segments.text: Honestly the price is higher than we budgeted, and I am worried it will not survive procurement.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Fair. If the value case holds, where does the discount conversation need to land?

segments.speaker: PROSPECT
segments.text: The metrics we track say onboarding cost drops 30 percent with automation, so a 10 percent discount for a two year term would work.

segments.speaker: PROSPECT
segments.text: The CFO signs off on anything annual; the process is one procurement meeting then signature.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Then let's schedule the pricing review with your CFO - does next Tuesday work?

segments.speaker: PROSPECT
segments.text: Next Tuesday works. Send the quote over.
